falsifier.quote: fails** if a field's measured non-monetary distinction diversity is shown to hold or rise while its monetary indicators rise — the divergence signature of #1616 with the sign reversed.
falsifier.note: §33 Falsification conditions, entry for the recursive-selection claim.

falsifier.quote: fails** if a case can be produced in which a substrate holds inscription authority — determining what can be legibly written — without acquiring any interpretive-operational authority, and no jurisdiction over valid representation follows.

fails** if the monetary and epistemic cases can be shown to require incompatible mechanisms — for instance if the migration of valuer standing turns out to depend on institutional enforcement in a way the migration of knower standing does not, so that the shared "substrate acquires jurisdiction" reading is a verbal parallel rather than a structural one.

fails** if an exteriorization can be exhibited that is itself representable only monetarily — that is, if the operation of writing money's grammar, losses and jurisdiction turns out to be performable only by assigning prices, which would show the meaning layer to be a monetary substrate in disguise and the ordering to be a preference.
fails** if a meaning layer can be shown to be revisable by encounter and yet to reproduce closure at the next level for reasons internal to revision itself.
if a sustained run of audits produces classifications that no independent auditor reproduces from the same ledger.
fails** if closure and integrity can be shown to covary necessarily — if a sound inscription cannot be predatory and an unsound one cannot be a witness.
fails** if the six rates prove to measure one underlying quantity

if selection pressure proves unevidenceable in principle rather than merely unevidenced in a given audit — that is, if no observation could distinguish a distinction that lost operative standing from one that was never represented.
fails** if the distinction between the representable field and the total field can be shown to do no work — that is, if no valuation ever comes out differently for having carried the remainder.
fails** if reach differences prove to be monotone in inventory size across cases

fail individually** by counterexample: a valuation that commits one of them and is nonetheless demonstrably better than one that does not. They fail collectively if a valuation satisfying all fifteen can be shown to be systematically worse than an ordinary appraisal at the task the valuation was for.
if a sustained run of dossiers produces representations that no independent valuer reproduces from the same evidence.
falsifier.note: §28 of #1621; restated in #1626 §11 (line 343) in the same terms.
